sqlquery.from:
( select c.id, coalesce(c.firstname,'')||' '|| coalesce(c.lastname,'') leadname , c.primaryemail,ca.name caName,c.creationDate,modificationDate from "$".crmcontact c left join "$".crmAccount ca on c.crmAccount=ca.id
,(select distinct u.id userid,r.code roles from "$".myuser u join "$".myuser_role mr on u.id=mr.users_id and u.id=#?user_id?# join "$".role r on mr.roles_id=r.id) up
where c.deleted is not true and c.contacttype=5 and trim(coalesce(c.firstname,'')||' '|| coalesce(c.lastname,'')) != '' and ( (up.roles in ('ADMIN','SALESMAN')) or (true!=(up.roles in ('ADMIN','SALESMAN')) and (c.assignee=up.userid or c.backupAssignee=up.userid or c.owner=up.userid)) ) order by c.id desc ) t
